title: Dreyer's Grand Ice Cream recalls select Outshine Fruit Bars distributed nationwide
text:
Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream recalls select Outshine Fruit Bars distributed nationwide
Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream, Inc. announced on Aug. 26 a recall of select Outshine Fruit Bars, including Strawberry, Watermelon, Grape, Tangerine, and Black Cherry 6-count 2.5-ounce bars as well as the Outshine 24-count 2.5-ounce Variety Pack Fruit Bars. The affected products were distributed to retailers across Wyoming and throughout the United States.
The Wyoming Department of Agriculture Consumer Health Services division is contacting grocery chains to ensure awareness of the recall and that impacted products are removed from store shelves. According to Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream, no other Outshine products or varieties are affected by this recall; only the five specified flavors in the listed packaging sizes are included.
Consumers can identify recalled products by checking batch codes printed on product packaging. A full list of all recalled products is available through a link provided by Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream for verification purposes. Consumers who have purchased these items should check lot codes and dispose of any product included in the recall without consuming it.
For questions regarding the recall, consumers may contact Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream Customer Service at 800-392-4885 during business hours, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. EST, or email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) for media inquiries.
The company has released specific batch codes and best before dates associated with this recall for consumer reference.
